**Sub-fund level:** Under Irish UCITS rules, ETF status attaches to the **sub-fund**, not the umbrella. An umbrella is a single legal entity with segregated sub-funds. Only sub-funds that meet the ETF criteria (exchange listing with market-making, described as ETF features in the prospectus) are UCITS ETFs. The umbrella is not an ETF, and non-ETF sibling sub-funds must not be labelled as ETFs.

**Listed-class level:** Trading identifiers (ISIN, ticker, listing venue such as Euronext Dublin, LSE or Xetra) attach to each **listed share class**. Unlisted classes in an ETF sub-fund share its UCITS ETF status but have no exchange ticker. Describe them as unlisted classes of a UCITS ETF, not as exchange-traded products.
